title: Post-intro-call client email
prompt: Write an email to Casey, a new Space Tiger client. Tell her it was great to meet, give her the link to the payment page, and lay out the next steps.
context: We just had an intro call to learn about her and her business. The payment starts the Blueprint process. Next steps: 1) pay, 2) fill out the intake form, 3) book our Blueprint call. Payment link: [payment link]. Intake form: [intake form link]. Booking: [booking link].
criteria: No invented details (what we discussed, prices, dates, promises)
The three next steps are in order and easy to scan
Sounds like a person wrote it, not a template
Has a short, clear subject line
